mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pms_product WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND publish_status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM pms_product WHERE (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND publish_status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, create_time DESC

SELECT * FROM pms_product WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND publish_status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM pms_product WHERE category_id IN #{id} AND publish_status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, create_time DESC

SELECT * FROM pms_product WHERE category_id IN #{id} AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND publish_status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM pms_product WHERE recommend_status = 1 AND publish_status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC
SELECT * FROM pms_product WHERE new_status = 1 AND publish_status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE pms_product SET stock = #{stock}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE pms_product SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity}
